source_quote: Meta has released Muse Glimmer , a 30-billion-parameter multimodal model distilled from Muse Spark. It is tuned for always-on local agent workflows, and ships under Apache 2.0. A 30B model normally needs over 55 GB of memory at full precision. Meta compresses it to roughly 4-bit, then adds block-level speculative decoding so it answers fast enough to sit inside a real agent loop. The result runs on one consumer GPU or a Mac, with no network call.

Which companies : Solo developers and startups can run it on one 24 GB GPU or an M4/M5 Max Mac. Mid-market teams get on-prem inference without a per-token bill. Regulated enterprises get an air-gappable agent. Meta advises adding system-level guardrails rather than shipping the model as a bare endpoint.
